entries.title: Isaiah 21:1
segments: The burden of the wilderness of the sea. As whirlwinds in the South sweep through, it cometh from the wilderness, from a terrible land.

entries.title: Isaiah 21:2
segments: A grievous vision is declared unto me; the treacherous man dealeth treacherously, and the destroyer destroyeth. Go up, O Elam; besiege, O Media; all the sighing thereof have I made to cease.

entries.title: Isaiah 21:3
segments: Therefore are my loins filled with anguish; pangs have taken hold upon me, as the pangs of a woman in travail: I am pained so that I cannot hear; I am dismayed so that I cannot see.

entries.title: Isaiah 21:4
segments: My heart fluttereth, horror hath affrighted me; the twilight that I desired hath been turned into trembling unto me.

entries.title: Isaiah 21:5
segments: They prepare the table, they set the watch, they eat, they drink: rise up, ye princes, anoint the shield.

entries.title: Isaiah 21:6
segments: For thus hath the Lord said unto me, Go, set a watchman: let him declare what he seeth:

entries.title: Isaiah 21:7
segments: and when he seeth a troop, horsemen in pairs, a troop of asses, a troop of camels, he shall hearken diligently with much heed.

entries.title: Isaiah 21:8
segments: And he cried as a lion: O Lord, I stand continually upon the watch-tower in the day-time, and am set in my ward whole nights;

entries.title: Isaiah 21:9
segments: and, behold, here cometh a troop of men, horsemen in pairs. And he answered and said, Fallen, fallen is Babylon; and all the graven images of her gods are broken unto the ground.

entries.title: Isaiah 21:10
segments: O thou my threshing, and the grain of my floor! that which I have heard from Jehovah of hosts, the God of Israel, have I declared unto you.

entries.title: Isaiah 21:11
segments: The burden of Dumah. One calleth unto me out of Seir, Watchman, what of the night? Watchman, what of the night?

entries.title: Isaiah 21:12
segments: The watchman said, The morning cometh, and also the night: if ye will inquire, inquire ye: turn ye, come.

entries.title: Isaiah 21:13
segments: The burden upon Arabia. In the forest in Arabia shall ye lodge, O ye caravans of Dedanites.

entries.title: Isaiah 21:14
segments: Unto him that was thirsty they brought water; the inhabitants of the land of Tema did meet the fugitives with their bread.

entries.title: Isaiah 21:15
segments: For they fled away from the swords, from the drawn sword, and from the bent bow, and from the grievousness of war.

entries.title: Isaiah 21:16
segments: For thus hath the Lord said unto me, Within a year, according to the years of a hireling, all the glory of Kedar shall fail;

entries.title: Isaiah 21:17
segments: and the residue of the number of the archers, the mighty men of the children of Kedar, shall be few; for Jehovah, the God of Israel, hath spoken it.
